normalization: Require the exact list envelope and an array data field.
Require every row to have a non-empty string name, boolean enabled, and optional non-empty string tools array.
Ignore rows whose enabled value is not exactly true, including their configured state and tools.
Reject malformed rows, duplicate enabled names, hard-blocked enabled names, unknown enabled names, and enabled concrete tools.
The policy passes only when enabled toolset names and concrete tools are exactly empty.
